Our Shop

A Real Aurora Barbershop

Romero Barbershop is where Aurora comes for a cut done right. No rushing, no guesswork — just skilled barbers who take the time to get your look exactly the way you want it.

Whether it’s a sharp skin fade, a clean beard line or a classic hot-towel shave, you’ll leave looking like the best version of yourself. That’s the standard at every chair, every visit.

Good to Know

FAQ

Do you take walk-ins?

Walk-ins are always welcome. Booking ahead just guarantees your spot and your barber, especially on weekends.

How do I book an appointment?

Use the booking form above, call the shop, or tap the chat assistant in the corner — it can take your request in a few seconds.

Do you do beard work and shaves?

Absolutely. We do beard shaping, lineups and classic hot-towel straight-razor shaves.

What are your prices?

Pricing depends on your hair, the service and your barber. Just ask when you book or arrive and we’ll give you a clear quote.

What payment do you accept?

Cash and all major cards. Tips are always appreciated, never expected.
